listenings.text: Hello, and thank you for calling Paris City Tours. Here is the information for tomorrow. The city tour starts at ten in the morning. Please wait in front of your hotel, and be ready at a quarter to ten. The tour is three hours and it finishes at one o'clock. A guide comes with the group. Her name is Camille and she speaks English, French and a little Spanish. The group tomorrow is small: only twelve people. If you want to change the day, please call this same number before eight in the evening. Thank you very much, and have a very good day in Paris.

Good evening, this is a message from the hotel desk about your weekend. You asked about the park for your daughter, so here is the information. The train to the park leaves at nine in the morning, from the station near the hotel. It is forty minutes. Your daughter needs three things for the day: the ticket, a warm jacket and a bottle of water. October is not cold, but it is not warm in the morning. The park is open from ten to eight, and the shops close at seven. If there is a problem, you can call the hotel desk. We are open every day, all day. Have a very good weekend.

extra_audio.text: What tour do you have for tomorrow? When does it start? Who is the guide? How many people come with the group? Thank you. We are ready at a quarter to ten.
